apps.name: Fix a test
apps.why: The tests pass or fail in seconds, and one changed line is easy to undo.

apps.name: Tidy a folder
apps.why: A listing shows where every file went, and a move can be undone.

apps.name: Check invoices
apps.why: Rules can check the match, but money moves, so a person approves the payment.

apps.name: Coding agents
apps.why: Tests check each change in seconds, but a merge reaches real users.

apps.name: Customer support
apps.why: Nobody reads a reply before it is sent, and a wrong promise costs money.

apps.name: AlphaEvolve
apps.why: A program scores every attempt, and a poor attempt is thrown away.

apps.name: Clinic notes
apps.why: The doctor reads every note, and an error can reach a patient.

apps.name: IT incidents
apps.why: Metrics show whether a fix worked; a wrong rollback is an outage.

apps.name: Web forms
apps.why: The form can be read before it is submitted; a submission is final.

apps.name: Robot lab
apps.why: Instruments measure every result; reagents and time cost money.

apps.name: Hypotheses
apps.why: Only a lab can check an idea, but an idea alone harms nobody.

apps.name: Deep research
apps.why: Every citation must be opened and read to be checked.

apps.name: Farm advisory
apps.why: Farmers act on it, and a lost crop cannot be undone.
apps.zone: A person leads, the agent assists

zones.name: A person leads, the agent assists
